utilities.description: Counts a document's visible content, never its markup (fixes R3).

utilities.description:

utilities.name: createFeatureSet
utilities.description: Builds the active feature set from a list of enabled feature ids.
utilities.example:
``ts
const features = createFeatureSet(['bold', 'italic']);
features.has('paragraph'); // true — always enabled
features.has('heading');   // false
``

utilities.name: createId
utilities.description:
Returns a process-unique id with the given prefix, e.g. `rte-3`.

Deliberately not random: a stable, monotonic id keeps server and client markup
identical for the first render, and React's `useId` supplies the uniqueness that
actually matters across concurrent trees.

utilities.name: createTheme
utilities.description: Merges overrides onto a base theme.

utilities.name: createToolbarItem
utilities.description: Declares a toolbar item.

utilities.name: decodeEntities
utilities.description:
Decodes HTML entities in a string.

Applied repeatedly by decodeEntitiesDeep where double-encoding could hide a
payload.

utilities.name: decodeEntitiesDeep
utilities.description:
Decodes until the string stops changing, so `&#106;` cannot hide a `j`.

Capped at five passes: that is far more nesting than any real content has, and it
bounds the work an attacker can force.

utilities.name: definePlugin
utilities.description: Declares a plugin.

utilities.name: describeProfile
utilities.description: The profile a name resolves to, for tests and for the docs site's profile table.

utilities.name: detectOfficeSource
utilities.description: True when the markup came from Word, Google Docs or Excel.

utilities.name: detectPasteSource
utilities.description:
Identifies the origin of a clipboard payload (03 §3).

Detection drives which cleanup runs, and it is also surfaced to `handlers.onPaste`
so a consumer can apply a different policy to an office paste than to plain text.

utilities.name: documentToMarkdown

utilities.description: Extracts the visible text of a document.

documentToText(doc, { listMarkers: true, linkUrls: true }); // e-mail text/plain part
``

utilities.name: escapeAttribute
utilities.description:
Escapes a value for a double-quoted attribute.

`<` and `>` are escaped too. They are not strictly required inside an attribute,
but escaping them removes a whole class of mutation bugs if the output is ever
re-parsed in a different context.

utilities.name: escapeText
utilities.description: Escapes text for a text node: `&`, `<` and `>`.

utilities.description: The first descendant element matching `tag`, in document order.

utilities.name: findMark
utilities.type: (marks: Mark[] | undefined, type: T) => Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | Extract<object, object> | undefined
utilities.description: Looks a mark up on an inline node.

utilities.name: formatShortcut
utilities.description: Renders a binding for display, with the platform's glyphs.

utilities.name: getProfile
utilities.description: Returns a profile by name. The returned object is a fresh copy.

utilities.name: getProtocol
utilities.description: Extracts the scheme of a URL, or `null` when it is relative.

utilities.name: hasDomParser
utilities.description: True when this environment can parse HTML with `DOMParser`.

utilities.name: htmlToDocument
utilities.description:
Parses HTML into the portable document model.

Runs the whole input pipeline from 03 §3: source detection, interop, sanitization,
schema downgrade and normalization.

utilities.name: isApplePlatform
utilities.description: True when the current platform uses Cmd for `Mod`.

utilities.name: isBlockEnabled
utilities.description: True when a block type may appear with this feature set.

utilities.name: isEditorDocument
utilities.description: True for a well-formed document object.

utilities.name: isElement
utilities.description: Type guard for elements.

utilities.name: isEmptyDocument
utilities.description:
True when the document holds nothing a reader would see (fixes R2). `''`, `

`, `


`, whitespace-only content and a document of nothing but empty blocks are all empty. `

 

` is **not**: the author typed a character.

utilities.name: isEmptyHtml
utilities.description:
True when an HTML string holds no visible content (fixes R2). The cheap path for callers that only need the boolean and do not want to build a document: `''`, `'

'`, `'


'` and whitespace-only markup are empty, while `'

 

'` is not.

utilities.name: isExternalUrl
utilities.description: True when a URL points somewhere outside the current origin.

utilities.name: isMarkEnabled
utilities.description: True when a mark may appear with this feature set.

utilities.name: isText
utilities.description: Type guard for text nodes.

utilities.name: looksLikeQuill
utilities.description:
True when the markup looks like it came from Quill.

Used by source detection so a paste from the old editor is cleaned rather than
treated as arbitrary HTML.

utilities.name: markdownToDocument
utilities.description:
Parses Markdown into a document.

Implemented by converting to HTML and reusing the HTML pipeline, so Markdown input
gets the same sanitization, interop and schema downgrade as everything else.

utilities.name: markdownToHtml
utilities.description: Converts Markdown to HTML. Exported for the interop demo's before/after view.

utilities.name: marksEqual
utilities.type: (a: Mark[] | undefined, b: Mark[] | undefined) => boolean
utilities.description: True when two mark lists are equivalent, ignoring order.

utilities.name: matchesShortcut
utilities.description: True when a keyboard event matches a parsed binding.

utilities.name: meetsContrastAA
utilities.type: (foreground: string, background: string, largeText: boolean) => boolean
utilities.description: True when the pair meets WCAG AA for the given text size.

utilities.name: mergeLocalization
utilities.description: Deep-merges a partial catalogue onto a base one.

utilities.name: mergeSanitizeConfig
utilities.description: Merges a partial config onto a resolved one.

utilities.name: normalizeColor
utilities.description:
Normalizes a CSS colour to lower-case `#rrggbb`.

Returns `null` for a missing value or one that means "no colour", which is what makes
the picker's Reset remove the format instead of forcing black (fixes R14).

utilities.name: normalizeDocument
utilities.description:
Applies the normalization rules from 03 §2.

Runs after every parse and paste: merges adjacent identical marks, drops empty inline
nodes, optionally collapses empty blocks, and keeps a trailing paragraph so the user
can always get out of a table or a quote.

utilities.name: normalizeUrl
utilities.description:
Adds a default scheme to a bare host, as the link popover does (05 §6).

Leaves anything that already has a scheme, an anchor or a mail-like shape alone.

utilities.name: parseHtml
utilities.description:
Parses an HTML fragment into the internal tree.

`auto` (the default) uses the browser's `DOMParser` when one exists and the in-house
tokenizer otherwise. Passing `builtin` explicitly forces the portable path, which is
what the security tests use to exercise it inside a browser-like environment.

utilities.name: parseHtmlFragment
utilities.description: Parses an HTML fragment into the internal tree.

utilities.name: parseHtmlWithDom
utilities.description: Parses an HTML fragment with the browser's parser.

utilities.name: parseQuillMarkup
utilities.description: Converts legacy Quill markup into ordinary HTML.

utilities.name: parseShortcut
utilities.description: Parses a binding such as `'Mod+Shift+X'`.

utilities.name: parseStyle
utilities.description:
Splits an inline `style` value into declarations.

Semicolons inside `url(…)` and quoted strings do not terminate a declaration, which
is exactly where a naive `split(';')` goes wrong.

utilities.name: plainTextAlternative
utilities.description:
The `text/plain` alternative for a multipart e-mail (03 §5.3).

Links become `text (url)` and list items get markers, so the message still reads
correctly in a client that refuses HTML.
utilities.example:
``ts
plainTextAlternative(doc);
// 'Hi Jane

- Add 2 lbs of shock
- Re-test in 24h

See our site (https://example.com)'
``

utilities.name: pseudoize
utilities.description:
Accents and pads one string.

Interpolated values are left alone — `{count}` has to survive, and so does anything
the caller substitutes in.

utilities.name: readStyleProperty
utilities.type: (style: string | undefined, property: string) => string | null
utilities.description:
Reads one declaration out of an inline `style` value.

Used by the interop parsers, which need `text-align` and `color` before the document
model exists.

utilities.name: resolveIcons
utilities.description: Merges consumer overrides onto the defaults.

utilities.name: resolveMessage
utilities.type: (message: LocalizedString | undefined, values: Record<string, string | number>) => string
utilities.description: Resolves a message to a string.
utilities.example:
``ts
resolveMessage(t.counter.limit, { count: 231, max: 2048 }); // '231 / 2048'
resolveMessage('Hello {name}', { name: 'Jane' });           // 'Hello Jane'
``

utilities.name: resolvePluginOrder
utilities.description:
Resolves a plugin list: dependencies first, duplicates removed.

A plugin registered twice keeps its last definition, which is what makes
`addPlugins` able to replace a built-in by name.

utilities.name: resolvePlugins
utilities.description:
Resolves the plugin list for a set of props.

Order of precedence: `plugins` replaces the preset entirely, then `removePlugins`
drops names, then `addPlugins` appends, then the `enableX` flags turn individual
features off (04 §2.3).

utilities.name: resolveSanitizeConfig
utilities.description:
Turns the `sanitize` prop into a resolved configuration.

A config object is merged onto `standard`; `false` is handled by the caller, which
also emits the development warning (03 §4.2).

utilities.name: resolveSlots
utilities.description: Merges consumer slot overrides onto the defaults.

utilities.name: sanitizeHtml
utilities.description:
Sanitizes an HTML string against a profile or configuration.

Runs at every content boundary in both directions (03 §4.1). The hard rules in
03 §4.3 apply regardless of configuration.

utilities.name: sanitizeNodes
utilities.description:
Sanitizes an already-parsed tree.

Used by the interop parsers, which have a tree in hand and would otherwise have to
serialize and re-parse.

utilities.name: sanitizeStyle
utilities.type: (style: string, allowed: readonly string[], onViolation?: function) => string
utilities.description: Filters an inline `style` value against an allowlist.

utilities.name: scopedId
utilities.description: Builds a DOM id scoped to one editor instance.

utilities.name: serializeHtmlNodes
utilities.description: Serializes a list of nodes to an HTML string.

utilities.name: serializeStyle
utilities.description: Joins declarations back into an inline `style` value.

utilities.name: sortMarks
utilities.description: Returns the marks in canonical order.

utilities.name: text
utilities.description: Builds a text node.

utilities.name: textContent
utilities.description: Concatenates every text descendant of a node, in document order.

utilities.name: textToDocument
utilities.description:
Turns plain text into a document.

Double newlines become paragraphs and single newlines become line breaks, which is
what a plain-text paste should produce (03 §3).

utilities.name: themeToCssVars
utilities.description:
Flattens a theme — or a partial override — into `--rte-*` custom properties.

Unknown paths fall through to the kebab-cased default, so a theme extended with
tokens of its own still produces variables its own CSS can read.

utilities.name: validateMergeTagKeys
utilities.description: Reports merge-tag keys that are not in the allowed list (03 §6).

utilities.name: walkBlocks
utilities.description: Every block in the document, including those nested in quotes, lists and tables.

utilities.name: walkElements
utilities.type: (nodes: HtmlNode[], visit: function, parent: HtmlElement | null) => void
utilities.description: Depth-first walk over every element in a tree.

utilities.name: walkInline
utilities.description: Every inline node in the document, in document order.

types.name: Align
types.description: Block-level horizontal alignment. `left` is the default and serializes as no attribute.

types.name: AutosaveConfig
types.description: Autosave / draft behaviour (03 §7).

types.name: BaseHandlerContext
types.description: Every handler context carries the editor so middleware can read state.

types.name: BeforeChangeContext
types.description: Context for `onBeforeChange`: the change that is about to be committed.

types.name: BlockNode
types.type: ParagraphNode | HeadingNode | ListNode | BlockquoteNode | CodeBlockNode | HorizontalRuleNode | ImageNode | TableNode | RawHtmlNode
types.description: Anything that can live at the top level of a document.

types.name: BlockNodeName
types.description: The `type` discriminator of every BlockNode.

types.name: BlockquoteNode
types.description: A block quote, which may contain other blocks.

types.name: BlockSchemaEntry
types.description: What a block type needs in order to exist.

types.name: ButtonProps
types.description: Props for Button.

types.name: ChangeMeta
types.description: Metadata passed alongside every `onChange`.

types.name: ChangeSource
types.description: Where a change came from. Lets controlled consumers avoid feedback loops (R21).

types.name: CheckboxProps
types.description: Props for Checkbox.

types.name: CodeBlockNode
types.description: A fenced code block. Rich marks are not allowed inside.

types.name: ColorPaletteConfig
types.description: The colour picker's palette and behaviour (05 §2).

types.name: ColorPickerSlotProps
types.description: Context for the `ColorPicker` slot: palette, recents and the clear action (05 §2).

types.name: ColorScheme
types.description: `colorScheme` prop. `'auto'` follows `prefers-color-scheme`.

types.name: CommandBinding
types.description: What useCommand returns.

types.name: CommandContext
types.description: What a command handler receives.

types.name: CommandHandler
types.description:
A command handler, written as middleware.

Call `next()` to run the handler registered before this one (ultimately the
built-in). Return `false`, or simply do not call `next`, to cancel.

types.name: CommandId
types.description: Every known command id.

types.name: CommandOverrides
types.description: `commandOverrides` prop shape.

types.name: CommandPayload
types.description: The payload a given command takes.

types.name: CommandRegistry
types.description:
The built-in command catalogue, mapping each id to its payload.

Consumers add their own by augmenting this interface:

types.name: ContentSlotProps
types.description: Context for the `Content` slot: the contenteditable surface and its textbox semantics.

types.name: ContentWarning
types.description: Something dropped or downgraded while parsing content (03 §2).

types.name: CounterSlotProps
types.description: Context for the `Counter` slot: the count, the limit and the two threshold flags.

types.name: CountUnit
types.description: Unit used by `getLength`, `maxLength` and the counter.

types.name: CssDeclaration
types.description: One parsed declaration.

types.name: DeepPartial
types.description: Recursively optional. Used for theme and localization overrides.

types.name: Density
types.description: Layout density; scales button size, paddings and min-height.

types.name: DocumentToHtmlOptions
types.description: Options for documentToHtml.

types.name: DraftContext
types.description: Context for `onDraftSave` and `onDraftRestore`.

types.name: DropHandlerContext
types.description: Context for `onDrop`: what was dropped onto the content element.

types.name: EditorDocument
types.description: A whole document.

types.name: EditorEngine
types.description: An engine implementation. The default is the Lexical adapter.

types.name: EditorEvents
types.description: Events emitted by the editor instance (a superset of the engine's).

types.name: EditorInstance
types.description: The handle returned by `useEditor` and exposed through `editorRef` / `onReady`.

types.name: EditorPoint
types.description:
A normalized selection.

Paths address a node by its index chain from the document root, which keeps the
shape engine-independent and serializable.

types.name: EditorSelection
types.description: A selection range plus the flags toolbars care about.

types.name: EditorSnapshot
types.description: The snapshot `useEditorState` selects from.

types.name: EditorValue
types.description: A value in the currently configured ValueFormat.

types.name: EmailOutputOptions
types.description: Extra shaping applied by the `email` HTML profile (03 §5.3).

types.name: EmojiNode
types.description: A single emoji character. Emoji are plain text, never images.

types.name: EngineEvents
types.description:
Events the engine emits.

02 §2.2 lists all of these except `formatChange`, `copy`, `cut`, `compositionStart`
and `compositionEnd`. Those exist because the product layer genuinely needs them:
undo availability changes without the content or the selection changing, the
clipboard needs its own hooks, and no change event may fire mid-composition
(05 §15).

types.name: EngineHandle
types.description: A mounted engine. Everything the product layer is allowed to call.

types.name: EngineMountOptions
types.description: What the host hands the engine when mounting it.

types.name: FeatureFlagProps
types.description:
Feature toggles, sugar over plugin inclusion (04 §2.3).

Each flag adds or removes the plugin that provides it, so turning one off also takes
its toolbar item, keymap entry and schema rules with it. A format the schema does not
know is downgraded rather than dropped when content arrives carrying it.

types.name: FeatureId
types.description: A feature id, as used by `enableX` props and by `RtePlugin.provides`.

types.name: FindOptions
types.description: Find & replace options.

types.name: FindReplacePanelSlotProps
types.description: Context for the `FindReplacePanel` slot: query state, match position and actions.

types.name: FindResult
types.description: Result of a `find` call.

types.name: FloatingToolbarConfig
types.description: Floating / bubble toolbar behaviour (05 §10).

types.name: FocusHandlerContext
types.description: Context for `onFocus` and `onBlur`.

types.name: FormatState
types.description:
The formatting that applies to the current selection (04 §9).

A value-carrying mark is `null` when the selection is mixed, so a toolbar can render
an indeterminate state rather than lying about one of the values.

types.name: HandlerContext
types.description: The context type a given handler receives.

types.name: HandlerName
types.description: The name of any handler in RteHandlers.

types.name: HeadingLevel
types.description: Heading level, 1–6.

types.name: HeadingNode
types.description: A heading, `level` 1–6.

types.name: HorizontalRuleNode
types.description: A thematic break.

types.name: HtmlComment
types.description: A comment. Kept during parsing so conditional comments can be recognized.

types.name: HtmlElement
types.description: An element. `tag` is always lower-case; attribute names are always lower-case.

types.name: HtmlNode
types.description: Anything in the tree.

types.name: HtmlOutputSpec
types.description: `['tag', attrs, ...children]`, mirroring the ProseMirror/TipTap convention.

types.name: HtmlParserChoice
types.description: Which parser parseHtml should use.

types.name: HtmlParserRule
types.description: A DOM match used when parsing foreign HTML.

types.name: HtmlProfile
types.description: Output HTML dialect (03 §5.2).

types.name: HtmlSerializerRule
types.description: Rules for a serializer contributed by a plugin.

types.name: HtmlText
types.description: A text run. Already entity-decoded.

types.name: HtmlToDocumentOptions
types.description: Options for htmlToDocument.

types.name: IconButtonProps
types.description: Props for IconButton.

types.name: IconName
types.description: Every icon key, used by the docs site's icon gallery.

types.name: ImageAttrs
types.description: Image attributes as stored on an image node.

types.name: ImageNode
types.description: An image. `width`/`height` are intrinsic pixels and serialize as attributes.

types.name: ImageOptions
types.description: Image behaviour (05 §7).

types.name: InlineNode
types.type: TextNode | LinkNode | MergeTagNode | MentionNode | EmojiNode | LineBreakNode
types.description: Anything that can live inside a block.

types.name: InlineSuggestMenuItem
types.description: One row of an InlineSuggestMenuSlotProps list.

types.name: InlineSuggestMenuSlotProps
types.description:
Context for the `InlineSuggestMenu` slot.

The slash menu, mentions, emoji and merge tags all render through this one
primitive, so their popovers, keyboard model and a11y are identical (05 §10).

types.name: InsertOptions
types.description: Options for `insertContent`.

types.name: InteropInput
types.description: Which foreign dialects the input parser recognizes.

types.name: InteropOptions
types.description: `interop` prop (04 §2.4).

types.name: KeyDownContext
types.description: Context for `onKeyDown`: a key, and the command the keymap matched.

types.name: LineBreakNode
types.description:
A soft line break (`
`), as opposed to a new block.

types.name: LinkAttrs
types.description: Link attributes as stored on a link node and edited in the link popover.

types.name: LinkClickContext
types.description: Context for `onLinkClick`: a link inside the content was clicked.

types.name: LinkNode
types.description: An anchor. `rel` is normalized by the sanitizer when `target` is `_blank`.

types.name: LinkOpenContext
types.description: Context for `onLinkOpen`: a link is about to be followed.

types.name: LinkPopoverSlotProps
types.description: Context for the `LinkPopover` slot: the link being edited and its actions (05 §6).

types.name: ListItemNode
types.description: One item of a ListNode; may itself contain nested lists.

types.name: ListNode
types.description: A bullet, ordered or check list.

types.name: LocalizedString
types.description: A string, or a function of its interpolation values.

types.name: Mark
types.type: object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object
types.description:
An inline formatting mark.

Boolean marks carry no value; the value-carrying marks (`color`, `fontSize`, …)
keep their value as a CSS-ready string.

types.name: MarkdownOptions
types.description: Options for documentToMarkdown.

types.name: MarkdownRule
types.description: Rules for a Markdown serializer contributed by a plugin.

types.name: MarkdownShortcutConfig
types.description: One markdown input rule (05 §5).

types.name: MarkName
types.description: The `type` discriminator of every Mark.

types.name: MarkSchemaEntry
types.description: What a mark needs in order to exist.

types.name: MarkSpec
types.description: Declares a custom inline mark.

types.name: MaxLengthContext
types.description: Context for `onMaxLengthExceeded`: input that would pass the limit.

types.name: MentionCandidate
types.description: One mention search result.

types.name: MentionNode
types.description: An atomic `@mention` chip.

types.name: MentionsConfig
types.description: Mention behaviour (05 §10).

types.name: MenuOption
types.description: One row of a Menu.

types.name: MenuProps
types.description: Props for Menu.

types.name: MergeTagDefinition
types.description: One substitutable `{key}` token.

types.name: MergeTagLengthMode
types.description: How a merge tag contributes to the character count.

types.name: MergeTagNode
types.description: An atomic `{key}` placeholder that the backend substitutes (03 §6).

types.name: MergeTagParseOptions
types.description: Merge-tag parsing settings used while reading HTML.

types.name: MergeTagsConfig
types.description: Merge-tag behaviour (03 §6).

types.name: Middleware
types.description: A generic middleware: run before/around the default behaviour, or cancel it.

types.name: NodeSpec
types.description: Declares a custom node type to the engine and the serializers.

types.name: NormalizeOptions
types.description: Options for normalizeDocument.

types.name: OfficeCleanupOptions
types.description: Word / Google Docs / Excel paste cleanup knobs (03 §3).

types.name: OpenStateContext
types.description: Context for the handlers that wrap an open/closed transition.

types.name: OrderedListStyle
types.description: Ordered-list numbering style, mirroring the HTML `type` attribute.

types.name: ParagraphNode
types.description: A paragraph.

types.name: ParsedShortcut
types.description: A parsed binding.

types.name: PasteHandlerContext
types.description: Context for `onPaste`: what is on the clipboard and how it will be treated.

types.name: PasteMode
types.description: How a paste should be treated.

types.name: PasteSource
types.description: Where a clipboard payload came from.

types.name: PluginContext
types.description: What a plugin's `setup` receives. Everything registered here is cleaned up for you.

types.name: PluginSanitizeRules
types.description: Sanitizer additions. These widen the allowlist; they can never widen a hard rule.

types.name: PluginSerializers
types.description: Serializer contributions.

types.name: PopoverPlacement

types.name: PopoverProps
types.description: Props for Popover.

types.name: Position
types.description: Where to insert content relative to the current document.

types.name: PresetDefinition
types.description: A preset: its plugins plus the props it implies.

types.name: PresetName
types.description: The shipped preset names (05 §1.1).

types.name: QuillInteropOptions
types.description: Legacy Quill parsing / emitting knobs (03 §5.1).

types.name: RawHtmlNode

Raw HTML preserved verbatim.

Only produced by the `permissive` sanitization profile; every other profile drops

types.name: RenderContext
types.description: What `footer` and `renderX` render props receive.

types.name: ResolvedRteTheme
types.description: A theme with every token resolved, plus the prop defaults it carries (07 §4).

types.name: ResolvedSanitizeConfig
types.description: A fully expanded profile: every field resolved, ready to run.

types.name: ResponsiveValue
types.description: A value that can vary by breakpoint. Breakpoints match the demo site's scale.

types.name: RestoreDraftPromptSlotProps
types.description: Context for the `RestoreDraftPrompt` slot: when the draft was saved, and what to do.

types.name: RichTextEditorProps
types.description: The full prop surface of `<RichTextEditor>`.

types.name: RootSlotProps
types.description: Context for the `Root` slot: the editor plus every state flag CSS keys off.

types.name: RteClassNames

types.name: RteConfigValue
types.description:
The parts of the resolved props that UI components need.

Kept separate from the editor instance so a colour-palette change re-renders the
picker and nothing else, and so a slot never has to reach into the editor for
configuration that is really a prop.

types.name: RteContentProps
types.description: Props for RteContent.

types.name: RteContentViewProps
types.description: `<RteContentView>` props (04 §6).

types.name: RteCounterProps
types.description: Props for RteCounter.

types.name: RteDefaultsProviderProps
types.description: Props for RteDefaultsProvider.

types.name: RteFormatters
types.description: Number, date and file-size formatting hooks used by counters and the draft prompt.

types.name: RteHandlers

The overridable interaction surface.

context override) to run the built-in behaviour; skip it to cancel.

Replaceable icons (06 §9).

`--rte-icon-size`, so no icon package is ever pulled into a consumer's bundle.

types.name: RteLocaleProviderProps
types.description: Props for RteLocaleProvider.

types.name: RteLocalization
types.description: The full message catalogue.

A plugin.

Every built-in feature is one of these, which is what makes `enableX` props,
presets and third-party extensions the same mechanism.

types.name: RteRootProps
types.description: Props for RteRoot.

types.name: RteSlotProps

types.name: RteSlots

Every replaceable component.

The last dozen entries are primitives; overriding just those re-skins the whole
editor for a design system (06 §10).

types.name: RteStyles
types.description: Per-slot inline styles, either static or derived.

types.name: RteTheme
types.description: The token tree. Every field is optional in overrides via `DeepPartial`.

types.name: RteThemeProviderProps
types.description: Props for RteThemeProvider.

types.name: SanitizeConfig
types.description:
Fine-grained sanitizer configuration.

Anything omitted falls back to the profile the config is merged onto (`standard` by
default). The hard rules in 03 §4.3 cannot be re-enabled from here.

types.name: SanitizeContext
types.description: Context handed to a SanitizeConfig.transform hook.

types.description:
The element a SanitizeConfig.transform hook receives.

03 §4.3 writes this as a DOM `Element`. It cannot be one: the sanitizer also runs
on a server and in a worker, where there is no DOM, and `<RteContentView>` sanitizes
during SSR. The portable node carries the same three things a transform needs -- tag
name, attributes and children -- and is what both parser frontends produce.

types.name: SanitizeOption
types.description: The `sanitize` prop: a profile name, a config object, or `false` (unsafe).

types.name: SanitizeOptions
types.description: Options for sanitizeHtml and sanitizeNodes.

types.name: SanitizeProfileName
types.description: One of the four shipped profiles.

types.name: SanitizeViolation
types.description: A removal performed by the sanitizer.

types.name: SanitizeViolationContext
types.description: Context for `onSanitizeViolation`: something the sanitizer refused.

types.name: SelectionChangeContext
types.description: Context for `onSelectionChange`.

types.name: SelectionSnapshot
types.description:
An opaque snapshot that survives focus leaving the editor.

Toolbar controls save one on `mousedown` and the engine restores it before running
a command, which is what makes clicking a toolbar button apply to the text that was
selected (fixes R5).

types.name: SelectProps
types.description: Props for Select.

types.name: SerializeHtmlOptions
types.description: Options for serializeHtmlNodes.

types.name: SerializeOptions
types.description: Options accepted by every HTML/Markdown serializer entry point.

types.name: SetContentOptions
types.description: Options for `setContent`.

types.name: SlashItemSpec
